key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.83s): Initial archival pose of crocodile; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.96s): Mid-sequence articulation of crocodile; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.19s): Peak dynamic extension of crocodile over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.43s): Follow-through and settle of crocodile with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of crocodile (1.83s..5.43s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
